verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs describe connecting coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to its databases over MCP, with OAuth 2.1 auth (no API keys) and tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring. That is a first-party MCP server for a managed database service, where this axis clearly applies. Related docs say agents run on isolated read-only compute and have every query logged. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and in-depth setup/tool reference documentation beyond the summary description.
